topic.title: Training-Data Poisoning, Backdoors, and Reliable Unlearning
topic.overview: This topic studies malicious changes to training data and methods for removing or neutralizing unwanted learned behavior. Backdoor attacks associate a hidden trigger with an attacker-chosen output; defenses examine suspicious samples, training dynamics, or controlled interventions. Related unlearning work asks whether designated knowledge can be removed without damaging retained capabilities.
topic.whyItMatters: A model may perform well on ordinary tests while containing targeted vulnerabilities. Defense evaluation therefore needs to examine attacker adaptation, clean-task utility, and whether supposedly removed behavior can be recovered through subsequent learning.
topic.evolution: The representatives range from malicious learning and intrusion detection to modern poisoning and backdoor defenses. Recent work adds continual-learning guarantees and studies unlearning's collateral damage and relearning attacks. These directions broaden evaluation from immediate removal toward the durability and selectivity of a defense.
openQuestions: How can defenses be tested against adaptive attacks under realistic data access?
What evidence distinguishes durable unlearning from temporary suppression of an accessible representation?

papers.title: Adversarial Inputs for Linear Algebra Backends

papers.title: Backdoor Attacks in Token Selection of Attention Mechanism

papers.title: Bi-perspective Splitting Defense: Achieving Clean-Seed-Free Backdoor Security

papers.title: Circumventing Backdoor Space via Weight Symmetry

papers.title: Confidential Guardian: Cryptographically Prohibiting the Abuse of Model Abstention

papers.title: Does Low Rank Adaptation Lead to Lower Robustness against Training-Time Attacks?

papers.title: Position: Machine Learning Models Have a Supply Chain Problem

papers.title: PTTA: Purifying Malicious Samples for Test-Time Model Adaptation

papers.title: SPMC: Self-Purifying Federated Backdoor Defense via Margin Contribution

papers.title: Stealix: Model Stealing via Prompt Evolution

papers.title: System-Aware Unlearning Algorithms: Use Lesser, Forget Faster

papers.title: A Reliable Cryptographic Framework for Empirical Machine Unlearning Evaluation

papers.title: A Set of Generalized Components to Achieve Effective Poison-only Clean-label Backdoor Attacks with Collaborative Sample Selection and Triggers

papers.title: Backdoor Mitigation via Invertible Pruning Masks

papers.title: BackdoorDM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Backdoor Learning on Diffusion Model
papers.tldr: BackdoorDM unifies diffusion-model backdoor attacks, defenses, and evaluation tools in a comprehensive benchmark.

papers.title: BridgePure: Limited Protection Leakage Can Break Black-Box Data Protection

papers.title: DiffBreak: Is Diffusion-Based Purification Robust?

papers.title: FedRACE: A Hierarchical and Statistical Framework for Robust Federated Learning
papers.tldr: FedRACE combines feature refinement and statistical client screening to defend federated learning with partially frozen pretrained models.

papers.title: From Counterfactuals to Trees: Competitive Analysis of Model Extraction Attacks

papers.title: From Dormant to Deleted: Tamper-Resistant Unlearning Through Weight-Space Regularization

papers.title: Interpreting Emergent Features in Deep Learning-based Side-channel Analysis

papers.title: Lie Detector: Unified Backdoor Detection via Cross-Examination Framework

papers.title: MARS: A Malignity-Aware Backdoor Defense in Federated Learning

papers.title: Preference Learning with Lie Detectors can Induce Honesty or Evasion

papers.title: SNEAKDOOR: Stealthy Backdoor Attacks against Distribution Matching-based Dataset Condensation

papers.title: Taught Well Learned Ill: Towards Distillation-conditional Backdoor Attack

papers.title: Tracing Back the Malicious Clients in Poisoning Attacks to Federated Learning

papers.title: Virus Infection Attack on LLMs: Your Poisoning Can Spread "VIA" Synthetic Data

papers.title: A Statistical Framework for Analyzing Specification Resistance to Learnware-Inversion Risks

papers.title: Angel or Demon: Investigating the Plasticity Interventions’ Impact on Backdoor Threats in Deep Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Anti-Backdoor Coreset Selection via Cumulative Entropy

papers.title: CREDIT: Certified Ownership Verification of Deep Neural Networks Against Model Extraction Attacks

papers.title: From Internal Diagnosis to External Auditing: A VLM-Driven Paradigm for Data-Free Online Backdoor Defense
papers.tldr: PRISM adapts an independent vision-language auditor online to defend against backdoors without training data or changes to the protected model.

papers.title: How does Bayesian Sampling help Membership Inference Attacks?

papers.title: Mechanistic Anomaly Detection via Functional Attribution

papers.title: Membership Inference Attacks for Unseen Classes
